bug_shape: scoped_admission.py binds base_heads to current snapshot repositories and evidence rule_heads, then uses the same heads for runtime candidate ancestry and source comparison. A v49-based bounded candidate therefore exposes inherited unrelated source; replacing rule authority or weakening overlap guards would be incorrect. The same gate also parses all historical non-row board context before excluding unrelated task rows, so unrelated historical context/malformed row shapes can block this new task. Correct only authenticated v2 foreign-source relevance; keep candidate/dependency writes and existing v1/no-scope behavior strict.
